svg.text: Leakage: the share of struck sub-tokens kept as current text. Each mark is one arm on one set, pooled over its pages.
Cost: $ per 1,000 pages on a log axis, filled at the price recorded and ringed at list price where a promotion makes them differ.
Leakage is on a square-root axis, so the low rates the best arms reach stay apart.
Labels give the rung (p1–p3: R1's paraphrases); hover a mark for its numbers.
G2: US Senate bills, the tested set
